nodes.label: autoVSL Agent System Map (AGENTS.md)
nodes.rationale: Declares the project a multi-agent ad factory: five skills chained research -> write -> produce. Agents never call each other directly - they hand off through files (banks/, research/, products/<slug>/, framework/, scripts/, output/), keeping each agent independently runnable and auditable.

nodes.label: Prospector Agent (research by longevity)
nodes.rationale: Researches proven winners (30+ days of spend), competitor teardowns, and customer language from ad libraries and reviews (web/Apify); writes banks/ and research/ reports. Its Modes 4/5 are the only writers allowed to change bank entry status.

nodes.label: Bloodhound Agent (research by velocity)
nodes.rationale: Tracks what is trending NOW (sounds, formats, memes, cultural moments) - perishable and dated; writes expiry-dated trend_jack bank entries and research/trends/ reports. Complements prospector's durable research with fresh signals.

nodes.label: Brand Platform Builder Agent
nodes.rationale: Builds brand identity, voice, positioning, naming, mascot, and avatar from a product brief; runs once per product so the writer pulls tone from it.

nodes.label: VSL Writer Agent (copywriter skill)
nodes.rationale: Turns research + brand voice into scripts, avatars, angles, and shot lists via the staged framework (intake -> avatar -> angles -> scripts -> shot list), writing products/<slug>/ scripts whose frontmatter must cite the bank ids used (no ids = unmeasurable = not finalized).

nodes.label: VSL Editor Agent (production skill)
nodes.rationale: Turns a finished script plus source/avatar footage into a finished captioned MP4 (voice-clone -> new VO -> lip-sync -> captions) using the fal.ai + ffmpeg pipeline; hard-won production rules (stop for text edit, per-video triage, fal gotchas) live in its SKILL.md.

nodes.label: banks/ Shared JSONL Data Contract
nodes.rationale: The shared JSONL banks (hooks, angles, pain-points, b-roll) that prospector and bloodhound write and the writer/editor/dashboard query; schemas in .claude/skills/prospector/references/output-schemas.md. Acts as the file-based message bus between agents.
